title: New customers complete the approved two-stage onboarding tour
steps: Run the onboarding package test suite on this branch.
Exercise first-run start choices, the ten-step ready-site tour, real composer actions, Edit selection and acknowledged Comment submission.
Render the registered overlay with the Vietnamese lookup; walk translated navigation and all three composer chip sends. Exercise localized Edit and selected-box Send with matching acknowledgements.
expect: The start screen exposes three choices and uses the real Create a new site control.
The ready-site tour keeps ten consecutive counters when start cards unmount.
Edit only advances after actual mode, selection and an acknowledged send.
Composer chips submit through the current session input actions, and completion is remembered.
Tour headings, body, navigation, progress aria labels and interpolated counters use the supplied locale lookup; every composer chip sends its displayed translated text.
Translated Edit and selected-box Send controls advance the tour; people-only notes, other requests and send intent without acknowledgement cannot advance it.

tests: a new web account enters step 1 directly
the first screen has three choices
site story keeps ten consecutive counters

selected-box Enter accepts only its own successful request
